title: Novartis raises blockbuster drug forecasts to $18 billion as it seeks to prove growth can last
summary_full: The drugmaker cited strong demand for its blockbuster drugs as it upgraded peak sales forecasts for multiple sclerosis, leukemia, and cholesterol medicines.
summary_public: The drugmaker cited strong demand for its blockbuster drugs as it upgraded peak sales forecasts for multiple sclerosis, leukemia, and cholesterol medicines.
